privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use and protect your personal data.

p: The controller of this website is Lock & Loft (Valencia, Spain). For any privacy question, write to info@lockandloft.com.

We store the information you give us: your answers in the consultation form (investment goal, area and property preferences, budget, rental expectations, requested services and notes), your name, email address, phone number, messages sent through the contact form, and your account password. The password is stored only in encrypted form; we cannot see it.
We use a small cookie to remember your language. Our emails also record opens, clicks and bounces (see below).

To assess your consultation request, prepare suitable properties and services for you, manage your account and reply to your messages. The legal basis is handling your request (pre-contractual steps) and the consent you give when creating your account.
Newsletters are sent only if you tick that option separately; the legal basis is your explicit consent.
If you subscribe, we send you new properties, market updates and investment guides. The emails we send record open and link-click statistics, which we use to see which content is useful.
You can unsubscribe at any time from the link in every email or from your account settings. We record the date you unsubscribed and send no further newsletters.

Messages you type into the site's chat assistant are sent to DeepSeek's AI service to generate a reply. This provider's servers may be located outside the European Economic Area, including in China. Please do not share passwords, ID or passport numbers, payment details or other sensitive information in the chat.

The name, email and phone number you leave in the chat's contact form are not sent to the AI model; they reach only us so we can get back to you. Conversations are stored in our system so we can follow up and improve the service; you can ask for deletion at info@lockandloft.com. The assistant can make mistakes and does not give legal or financial advice.

We do not sell your data. To run the site we use these providers: Supabase for the database and accounts, and Resend for sending email. They process data only on our behalf and under our instructions. If a transfer outside the European Economic Area is needed, legal safeguards such as standard contractual clauses apply.
Your request may be shared with partner lawyers, the RE/MAX office and service partners to the extent needed to serve you; we will discuss this with you first.
We keep your data while your account is active and the service relationship continues. If you ask us to delete your account, we delete the data except what we must keep by law.

You have the right to access, correct and delete your data, restrict or object to its processing, and receive it in a portable format; you can also withdraw your consent at any time. Just write to info@lockandloft.com.
If you are not satisfied with our reply, you can complain to the Spanish data protection authority (AEPD, www.aepd.es).
We use no advertising or tracking cookies. There are only records the site needs to work: your chosen language and, if you are logged in, your session.
If we update this policy, we will publish the new version on this page and change the date above.
